parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::int AS year, $2::jsonb AS data
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO zoe.festivos (fecha, nombre, pais, activo)
  SELECT (f->>'fecha')::date, f->>'nombre', 'CO', TRUE
  FROM input, jsonb_array_elements(input.data) AS f
  ON CONFLICT (fecha) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING fecha
)
SELECT
  (SELECT year FROM input)                              AS target_year,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inserted)                       AS festivos_creados,
  zoe.fn_aplicar_festivos_a_bloqueos((SELECT year FROM input))
                                                        AS bloqueos_creados;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ number: $json.number, text: $json.text, options: { delay: 400, presence: 'composing' } }) }}
